description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for performing security audits within the openclaw project, including configuration validation, external dependencies, and runtime checks.

methods.name: loadChannelPlugins
methods.description: Dynamically imports and caches the channel plugins module.

methods.name: loadAuditNonDeepModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports and caches the non-deep audit runtime module.

methods.name: loadAuditDeepModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports and caches the deep audit runtime module.

methods.name: loadAuditChannelModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports and caches the audit channel collection module.

methods.name: loadPluginRegistryLoaderModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports and caches the plugin registry loader module.

methods.name: loadGatewayProbeDeps
methods.description: Loads and caches dependencies needed for gateway probing.

methods.name: countBySeverity
methods.description: Counts security findings by severity level.

methods.name: normalizeAllowFromList
methods.description: Normalizes a list of allow-from entries into a string array.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Type guard to cast unknown to a record object.

methods.name: hasNonEmptyString
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-empty string.

methods.name: collectFilesystemFindings
methods.description: Performs filesystem permission checks and returns findings.

methods.name: collectGatewayConfigFindings
methods.description: Analyzes gateway configuration for security issues and returns findings.

methods.name: isStrictLoopbackTrustedProxyEntry
methods.description: Determines if a trusted proxy entry is explicitly loopback.

methods.name: collectBrowserControlFindings
methods.description: Checks browser control configuration and profiles for security issues.

methods.name: collectLoggingFindings
methods.description: Checks logging configuration for security risks.

methods.name: collectElevatedFindings
methods.description: Analyzes elevated tool allowlists for security issues.

methods.name: collectExecRuntimeFindings
methods.description: Checks runtime execution configuration and policies.

methods.name: collectOpenExecSurfacePaths
methods.description: Identifies open execution surface paths in configuration.

methods.name: collectAutoAllowSkillsHits
methods.description: Detects auto-allowlist settings for exec approvals.

methods.name: collectInterpreterAllowlistHits
methods.description: Detects interpreter allowlist entries missing strict inline eval.

methods.name: maybeProbeGateway
methods.description: Performs a deep probe of the gateway and returns the result.

methods.name: createAuditExecutionContext
methods.description: Creates context for running security audits, resolving configs and dependencies.

methods.name: runSecurityAudit
methods.description: Main function to perform comprehensive security audit and generate report.
